personality.summary: Gentle, earnest and self-sacrificing; he teaches classmates seriously, respects teachers, and accepts dangerous paths only after full awareness of the cost.
values: earning the right to be a knight
flaws: pushes his body and lifespan beyond safe limits
often does not notice the romantic turmoil around him

relationships.stella-vermillion: Girlfriend and rival; absent or asleep in several stories but the center of Stella's anxieties and affections.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister whose intense love and rivalry with Stella revolve around him.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Friend and observer of Shizuku's emotional struggles.
relationships.yuri-oreki: Teacher and entrance-exam examiner who first recognized and worried about his self-destructive path.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Student council member who supports him during the poltergeist hunt.

periods.summary: Vol-08 frames Ikki through side episodes and an origin story. After defeating Kirihara, he demonstrates sword techniques to classmates and reveals he has memorized 126 sword styles, including Stella's Imperial Arts. His kindness toward classmates and care for Shizuku motivate both Stella's attraction and Shizuku's jealousy. During the poltergeist incident he teams with Kanata, trusts her Diamond Dust support, captures a telekinetic monkey and learns Kanata's noblesse-oblige creed. The final Episode0 reveals his entrance exam: he challenged Yuri Oreki because he knew she was the strongest present, copied and evolved her sword style, endured Violet Pain, used Ittou Shura and a blade-stealing counter, and won admission while refusing to abandon the knight's path despite Oreki's warning.

key_events.summary: Shows classmates sword fundamentals and explains his 126 memorized sword styles.
Teams with Kanata to capture the telekinetic monkey behind the school poltergeist incidents.
Defeats Yuri Oreki in the entrance exam and earns admission to Hagun.
